title: Create a string utility module with tests
description:
In the workspace, create a small Node.js (ESM) package that exports a function `slugify(input)` and a function `wordCount(input)`.

Requirements:
- Language: JavaScript (Node ESM). Create package.json with `"type": "module"` and a `test` script.
- Use the built-in test runner: `node --test`.
- slugify(input): lowercase, trim, replace any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Empty or all-symbol input returns an empty string.
- wordCount(input): number of whitespace-separated tokens in the trimmed input; empty input returns 0.
- Files: package.json, src/index.js, test/index.test.js (or equivalent).
- Write real tests covering: normal input, empty input, punctuation-only input, repeated separators, unicode letters.
- Run `npm test` (or `node --test`) and make sure every test passes before you report DONE.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with type=module and a test script that runs the tests
test files exist and exercise the edge cases listed in the description
